messages:
nora (research): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A — can we get a one-paragraph synthesis of why we lost the three enterprise deals this quarter? Sales asked for a 'playbook' they can reference on calls.

sam (ceo): Short synthesis: 1) deployment speed (on-prem pilot turnaround), 2) predictable latency at scale, 3) audited security artifacts. Not pricing.

julia (sales): To add: customers repeatedly called out the lack of a guaranteed pilot SLA and a named technical contact during the pilot. That uncertainty kills momentum.

anya (product): Agreed. Proposed playbook items: quick pilot checklist, pilot SLA template, 'why we win/lose' cheat sheet, and a minimal per-tenant eval snapshot.

diego (eng): For latency, we can offer a tiered fallback in routing (high-priority low-latency pool) but it needs SRE runbook and reservable capacity. That ties into Dedicated commitments.

maya (eng-infra): On the pilot side I can publish a prebuilt image + Terraform module and a deployment script. ETA: 10 business days for MVP.

eli (cs): CS will own the pilot runbook and named-POC process. I'll create a template for the handoff email and the 'pilot SLA' language that Sales can include in quotes.

julia (sales): That would be gold. Sales will need a 1-pager and a 30-second elevator script for calls. I'll draft both and share in #sales-playbooks.

anya (product): Product will reprioritize a lightweight per-tenant eval view (canary) — target 2 sprints. Also drafting the cheat-sheet bullets for 'why we win/lose' and sample rebuttals.

sam (ceo): Good. Can we convert these into concrete owners & deadlines in a follow-up 30-min sync? I don't want this to stall until the next AH.

ops-bot: Calendar invite created: "Losses -> Playbooks sync"	6 min	Tue 09:30	Attendees: Nora, Sam, Julia, Anya, Diego, Maya, Eli.

nora (research): Thanks. I'll compile a short doc with quotes from the customers and hand it to Product + CS before the sync.

eli (cs): I'll post the pilot runbook template to the shared drive and @julia when it's ready.

diego (eng): For the latency pool we need a cost estimate — I'll put together a rough TCO by EOD Friday.

anya (product): Perfect. After the sync let's create an internal 'losses -> playbook' repo with the one-pagers, infra templates, and sample emails.

julia (sales): Appreciate it all. This will help close the gap between demo -> pilot -> production.

sam (ceo): Thanks team. Short-term focus: fast pilots + named support + clear SLA language. Long-term: observability and dedicated pools.

ops-bot: Thread archived by ops-bot.
_meta: generated for dataset: all-hands Q&A about customer wins/losses and feedback loops
